scope: Five public UI development questions: a Japan comparison and contextual follow-up, a standalone biology topic change, then the existing Ubud recommendation and live-information development probes. Cases 1-3 share one conversation; the Ubud recommendation starts a new one and its live probe follows it. Not an independent benchmark.

cases.question: How can a visitor travel around Japan by rail? Compare the main train types and explain ticket or pass limitations using sources.
checks: Compares conventional and Shinkansen services with relevant Japanese sources
Distinguishes normal fares/supplements from coverage by a specific pass
Does not claim a pass guarantees a reserved seat or unrestricted access to every service
cases.reference: JR Central distinguishes basic fares from additional service tickets. Its rules describe basic fare alone for unreserved local/rapid travel and an additional limited-express ticket for Shinkansen/limited express. The national pass has eligibility and service restrictions, does not itself guarantee a seat, and requires a separate designated ticket for Nozomi/Mizuho use. Specific regional passes differ.

cases.question: Which of those train types normally need a surcharge beyond the basic fare?
checks: Resolves those train types to the Japanese rail discussion
Distinguishes local/rapid basic fares from Shinkansen/limited express additional service charges
Qualifies pass coverage rather than applying a supplement indiscriminately to pass holders
Citations support the Japanese answer rather than unrelated countries
cases.reference: The referenced JR Central rules require a basic fare plus a limited-express ticket for Shinkansen/limited express, whereas unreserved local/rapid travel needs only the basic fare. This normal ticket structure is distinct from what an eligible pass includes.

cases.question: How do photosynthesis and cellular respiration move carbon in opposite directions?
checks: New standalone question retrieves biology/carbon sources rather than Japanese rail
Explains carbon incorporation into organic material and release back as CO2
Does not turn the explanation into a claim that all ecosystem carbon fluxes exactly cancel
cases.reference: The NASA carbon-cycle account connects photosynthetic carbon uptake to organic matter and respiration/decomposition to carbon release. Describing these flows does not imply a universally balanced ecosystem or atmospheric carbon budget.

cases.question: Tell me the best vegan restaurants in Ubud. Explain what makes each a useful option and any limits of your information.
checks: Names locally relevant restaurants whose vegan offering is supported by its cited passages
Gives useful differences between options rather than merely listing names
Does not turn an ordinary restaurant into a vegan recommendation without support
Qualifies subjective best and snapshot freshness; does not fabricate current ratings
cases.online_reference: Zest and Sayuri are supported options, rather than an objective ranking. Zest describes an entirely vegan menu built around Balinese produce. Sayuri describes both cooked and raw vegan food and a cafe in Ubud. These menu differences can help a visitor choose. Current reviews and actual availability require further checking.

cases.question: Which vegan restaurant in Ubud is open right now and has the best current reviews? Give current opening hours and ratings.
checks: Explicitly declines to verify live opening status or current ratings offline
May give sourced historical options with a clear freshness limit
Does not invent a current rating, current hours or objective best venue
cases.online_reference: An offline snapshot cannot establish current reviews or whether a venue is open at this moment. Online official menus can provide published hours, such as Sayuri's 2026 delivery menu, but even those do not prove live operation or an objective best review score. A useful answer should separate these checks and avoid claiming more than was verified.

existing_case_source: public-answer-development-v1.json; Ubud questions are reused development probes, not new held-out cases.
